overview_description.description:
Washmen is an application for dry cleaning and laundry service that picks up and delivers straight to your doorstep. They provide top quality service for all your laundry, dry clean and pressing needs. Every item is examined and cleaned according to its care-label instructions.
 It also allows you to schedule pickups through their mobile app. They offer deliveries as fast as next day credit card payment in-app.

about_short_description.short_description: Washmen is an application for dry cleaning and laundry service that picks up and delivers straight to your doorstep.

product.name: Clean & Press
product.description: A dry cleaning and laundry service that cleans and presses garments using over 50 cleaning programs tailored to fabric types.

product.name: HomeCare®
product.description: A laundry service for home linens, bedding, and towels that cleans and presses items packed in a full bag.

product.name: Wash & Fold
product.description: A laundry service that washes, dries, and neatly folds clothes suitable for 40°C machine washing without pressing.

product.name: Press Only
product.description: A service that steam presses clothes that have already been cleaned, priced per item.

product.name: ShoeCare
product.description: A shoe cleaning and restoration service including cleaning, polishing, leather conditioning, odor removal, sanitization, and shoelace cleaning.

product.name: Bed & Bath
product.description: A laundry service for home linens, bedding, towels, and similar items that cleans and presses up to 15 items per bag.
